    Revised `splitPayment` in `LegacyTellerTerminal`:
    ```java
    public List<String> splitPayment(String fromAccountId, String amount, List<String> payeeIds) {
        Account from = store.find(fromAccountId);
        if (payeeIds == null || payeeIds.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("NO PAYEES");
        }
        BigDecimal total = MoneyUtil.parse(amount);
        if (total.compareTo(from.getBalance()) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("INSUFFICIENT FUNDS");
        }

        long totalCents = total.movePointRight(2).setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).longValue();
        int numPayees = payeeIds.size();
        long baseShareCents = totalCents / numPayees;
        long remainderCents = totalCents % numPayees;

        from.setBalance(from.getBalance().subtract(total));

        List<String> shares = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < numPayees; i++) {
            Account p = store.find(payeeIds.get(i));
            long centsToGive = baseShareCents + (i < remainderCents ? 1 : 0);
            BigDecimal share = BigDecimal.valueOf(centsToGive).movePointLeft(2);
            p.setBalance(p.getBalance().add(share));
            shares.add(MoneyUtil.format(share));
        }
        return shares;
    }
    ```

    ```java
    public class PaymentSplitter {
        public List<Long> calculateShares(long totalCents, int numPayees) {
            long baseShare = totalCents / numPayees;
            long remainder = totalCents % numPayees;
            List<Long> shares = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < numPayees; i++) {
                shares.add(baseShare + (i < remainder ? 1 : 0));
            }
            return shares;
        }
    }
    ```
